reviews.text:
My experience at the clinic was overwhelmingly positive!
I was very well received by Ana, who made my Iraci feel very comfortable and loved! Then we had a consultation with Dr. Daniel, who was very helpful, kind, humane, and professional. His service was perfect from beginning to end, answering all my questions and helping me with how to proceed with my girl. I also have to praise a Brazilian employee whose name I don't know, but who also deserves recognition for her service and care.
In short, I can only thank Vets e Pets 🙏🏽
I highly recommend it!

It's professionals of this caliber that make us trust them with our best friends! From the reception to the assistance and care provided by Dr. Alexandre, it was excellent!!

We became clients and we recommend them!
Extremely helpful and friendly. Impeccable service.

Dr. Bruno, Elsa, Beatriz, Samuel, and all the other staff at the clinic. Thank you for everything you did for Gato ❤️. I have no words for the professionals you are. Unfortunately, the outcome wasn't the best, but you never gave up on my four-legged baby until you couldn't anymore. I will certainly always mention you whenever I'm asked for clinic recommendations. Gato loved you all very much too 😘. Thank you for the gesture of commemorating him with a plaster cast of his paw.
When I have another cat, it will certainly be treated there ❤️. Best wishes to all.
Experience and quality in the service provided. They weren't afraid to show what goes on inside the clinic; I liked it, thank you for the care you showed the animals....
All the doctors are excellent, I don't have a preference, but my cat does prefer Dr. Alexandre, I don't know why, only he knows :D
The telephone is just for decoration.
Impeccable service
We are from Mexico and came for a European passport for our pet, as well as a health certificate so we can travel. The service was excellent, from reception to the doctors.
Really nice place and very friendly stuff! It was a calm visit for me and my dog :)
Excellent!

The professionals at this clinic are excellent. Dr. Bruno operated on my dog ​​and showed great care throughout the post-operative period. I am truly very happy to have found this clinic.

Negative point: It would be easier if they offered service via WhatsApp; it would greatly facilitate communication. After much persistence, we managed to speak with the team and schedule the appointment.
I don't recommend it.
I highly recommend it.
Dr. Alexandre is an excellent veterinarian. He was very attentive to my dog. The entire staff was very friendly.

They don't solve problems, they only care about your money. They had my dog ​​on medication, several consultations, and tests for an infection, but it was a fungal infection. They claimed they sent samples for analysis, but that wasn't true because the diagnosis wasn't infectious. These are bad professionals who don't love animals; they only care about making money off them. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone.
I had an excellent experience; Dr. Pedro was very attentive and gentle with my dog, who is quite scared and timid.
Excellent professionals! Especially Dr. Bruno.

I visited twice, and on both occasions the veterinarians were extremely professional and careful. My negative review stems from the fact that they never answer the phone when I try to call, so I always had to go to the location to schedule an appointment. The last time I tried, the assistant had the consulting room lights off and was hiding behind the counter, as if he wanted to make it seem like it was closed. I requested an appointment, I had free time and therefore plenty of availability, and the assistant scheduled it for a public holiday. I wasn't surprised because many services are open on holidays. When the day and time arrived, I went with the animal and the consulting room was closed. I didn't receive any attempt to contact me before or after the holiday – I don't understand how they see an appointment for a day when they are closed and don't try to contact me to reschedule. I gave my name and the animal's name to make the appointment, and it was several days in advance of the appointment date, however they didn't try at all to contact me to let me know they had made a mistake.

They clearly aren't interested in keeping me as a client, so I now go to another veterinary clinic.

It was Mica's first time at this clinic, she was seen by Dr. Bruno, and I have nothing but praise! He was super attentive and explained everything very patiently. The clinic is also excellent – ​​a clean, organized environment with a very welcoming team, starting at reception (I forgot to ask the name of the girl who was there, but she was very friendly). You can see that everyone really cares about the animals.
The service is very professional, all the staff are attentive and detail-oriented. They have protocols with insurance companies. I recommend them!!!

I went to the vet and was refused help for my dog ​​because the doctor had already left at 7 pm. The nurse refused to say he was busy and couldn't see the dog. The clinic has a 24-hour emergency service. I arrived twenty minutes before 8 pm, waited five minutes, and was arrogantly told what time it was, even though the clinic is open later.
A wonderful group of professionals. They continue to be top-notch. Congratulations!

Dr. Alexandre has always been spectacular in his care and attention to my little dog Leo! My husband and I have immense affection for the clinic as a whole, because throughout the time we lived in Porto (more than 2 years) we were always well attended to and treated, and we could trust in the excellent treatment of the doctor and the entire team with our old dog.
With the quality of an intern who almost killed my cat... Change the staff back to what you had in January/February 2024...
Very professional staff!
Excellent service, exemplary in everything: friendliness, hygiene, great facilities, treatment with care for our pets, five-star professionalism. ❤️

Excellent service, friendliness, and professionalism.
The well-being of animals is a priority for this team.
We think our "Mimo" agrees with us too? 🐱
Thank you …

Unfortunately, I had a terrible experience. My dog ​​died, and we could have prevented it.
About seven months ago, we took my dog ​​to this vet (I read the reviews and trusted him). I took him because his breath had bad breath, and the vet said he needed a dental cleaning, but that we should wait a month during which we would give him supplements (he was 13 years old) so he would be stronger for the anesthesia. I thought it was great, so we did, and they cleaned his teeth. It went well, but two weeks later, he was again coughing up strange mucus from his nose. Before the surgery, they did blood tests and a chest x-ray and told us everything was fine.
We went back for a follow-up appointment to find out what was wrong with the mucus, and he prescribed antibiotics for the second time. A month passed, and he was better, but a few days later, the bad breath and mucus returned. We went back for another appointment, and AGAIN, he prescribed antibiotics WITHOUT doing any further tests. His teeth weren't very clean afterward and quickly became very dirty again. We trusted them and gave him antibiotics again. Every time my dog ​​took antibiotics, he vomited, refused to eat, and another important factor: he had kidney disease and a history of seizures.

The mucus returned, and I went back to the vet to tell him we really needed to do something to help Nacho (the dog), and all he said was, "He needs to be on antibiotics forever." Hearing that, I left and never went back. You can become resistant to antibiotics, and you also get sick. Nacho felt terrible every time he took antibiotics.

Finally (after going to another vet first: also a Covelo antibiotic fanatic) and an emergency caused by that last vet, we arrived at a good vet who did a nasal X-ray where we saw he had a tumor! That no one else saw! Here at Vets & Pets, even though they had him in surgery and assured us they had checked his nose, they hadn't! It was a large tumor.

The service and hospitality might be good, but Nacho came out in tears and disoriented after a bath and haircut. Now I know he probably had a terrible time!
They need to study and improve. Horrible experience.
Excellent Professionals
Friendliness, collaboration and professionalism

All the professionals at the clinic are impeccable and incredibly caring towards our four-legged companions.
I also extend my affection and praise to Dr. Alexandre and his assistant Daniela, who cared for Margot with such care, attention, and empathy, qualities rarely found among many professionals.
Friendliness and professionalism far superior. I recommend them.
Always very well attended to.
Excellent. Dr. Alexandre is very good at what he does, treating pets with care and attention, with a thorough and attentive consultation. I recommend him!
Excellent clinic and professionals!

Top-notch service, with great care for my pet.

Thank you, I highly recommend this clinic.
